title: Circular Forefoot Rubbing
summary: Small circles are applied to the soft tissues under the bases of the toes.
instructions: Place the fingers under the toe bases.
direction: Small circles over forefoot soft tissue.
warning: Do not massage with recent injury, marked swelling, ulcers, infection, severe pain, or impaired sensation unless medically advised.
